name: Flying Button
description: Button that lifts off like a jet craft with a WebGL2 smoke and thrust simulation, hovers for a moment, then lands. It can be dragged while flying and optionally rides a ramp.
contents: Button with label, rounded body and thruster pods under it
WebGL2 canvas filling the container that draws smoke and thrust jets
Optional SVG ramp the button rides on
Custom cursor arrow shown when the cursor is carried by the craft
behavior: Takes off on hover or click, climbs to the set altitude, hovers, then descends back to rest
Fluid simulation produces smoke plumes, turbulence and ground splash under the thrusters
Craft tilts and wobbles while flying with spring physics
Can be grabbed and dragged around the area while flying
Optionally carries the mouse cursor, hiding the real cursor and drawing a custom arrow
Ramp mode makes the button ride along the ramp on click
Resizes with its container through a ResizeObserver
editableByProps: Label, click handler, size, corner radius and light or dark theme
Flight altitude, hover duration, number of jets (1 to 4) and thruster pods
Hover or click trigger, cursor carrying and ramp mode
Smoke amount, turbulence and wobble strength
Thrust, smoke, button, text and ramp colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change gravity, spring stiffness or damping of the flight
needsCodeEdit.where: G, SPRING and DAMP constants at the top of the file
The cursor svg path at the end of the FlyingButton return

fixed: Requires WebGL2, without it the smoke canvas cannot render
Root container fills its parent (h-full, w-full, min-height 240px) with overflow hidden, so the parent needs a defined size and the flight is clipped to it
Hides the system cursor inside the container while the cursor is carried
Supports pointer events and is built for mouse hover, touch gets click trigger behavior only through the trigger prop
Theme only accepts 'light', any other value uses dark
Trigger is forced to 'click' when ramp is true
Jets count is clamped to 1 to 4
Canvas resolution is capped at device pixel ratio 2
Color values for thrust, smoke and ramp are hex strings parsed by the shader helper
Heavy shader simulation, expect GPU cost on low end mobile devices
